note: S18 (2026-11-12): every line where the site could promise the customer an email, an SMS or an update, in one place. master-designer words them here, without touching code. `no_email` is shown while the provider does not send what the line needs; `email` only once a provider that really sends everything in `needs` is connected (S20, QA ת62: `needs` lists what the adapter must send: order_confirmation, shipping_update, delay_notice, invoice_email, back_in_stock, marketing; "any": any of them; @hd/shared/email). S20 (QA ת61): `contact` is shown when the shop has contact details (CONTACT_EMAIL in api/wrangler.jsonc, @hd/shared/contact), `no_contact` otherwise: it offers no contact the shop does not have. The page shows the contact block itself under a `contact` line. null: the line, or the whole control, is not shown. `text`: the same line always. A `no_email`, `text`, `contact` or `no_contact` line that promises an email, an SMS, a message or an update stops the build (tools/build-copy.ts, tools/lib/promises.ts), and so does an `email` line that promises what its `needs` do not list. Lines in one `group` are shown or hidden together.
